description: The current CRYPTOGRAPHICALLY SIGNED index price for one crypto asset, from the Pulse Verity Index across thousands of assets and dozens of venues — this result carries a signature you can verify: pass it unchanged to pulse_verify_print to check it OFFLINE, with no network call, against Pulse's public key. Each print carries signature, kid, grade, the number of independent venues (sources), dispersion in basis points and a confidence interval. Grades: consensus (3+ venues) and blended (2) are settleable; indicative (1 venue) is NOT. Use it when a price has to be defensible — settlement, an audit trail, a dispute — not merely current. Requires a Pulse API key via _apiKey. Example: pulse_signed_price({ symbol: "BTC" }).

_apiKey.description: Pulse Verity API key. Free and self-serve at https://thepulse.markets/developers (60 req/min, 25,000/month, no card).

symbol.description: Asset ticker as Pulse spells it, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL. pulse_asset_catalog lists coverage.

name: pulse_signed_price
